humanities_role_explanation: EXAMS-V is a general multi-discipline school-exam benchmark; about 53% natural sciences, and humanities subjects (History, Philosophy, Religion, Fine Arts, Ethics) are a minority of items. The competence tested is multilingual multimodal perception/OCR and reasoning over exam snapshots, not humanistic scholarship. Humanities questions are just exam items among others and are not reported as a distinct group.
benchmark_modalities_explanation: Each item is a cropped image snapshot containing the question text, options and any tables, figures, graphs or symbols interleaved; the model must do OCR and reasoning from the image alone.
analytical_tasks_explanation: Multiple-choice school exam questions across 20 subjects in 11 languages. Natural science items require 'intricate reasoning'; Geography and History need 'specific knowledge about particular regions or countries' (mapped to cultural_reasoning/factual_recall). Items combine text with tables, figures, graphs and scientific symbols, so visual reasoning and multilingual OCR are required.

general_purpose_benchmark.note: Broad multi-subject, multilingual, multimodal exam benchmark with 20 subjects and 11 languages.

evaluates_generative_llm.note: GPT-4V, Gemini-Pro-Vision, LLaVA-1.5-13B, Qwen-VL-7B, plus GPT-3.5-Turbo, GPT-4 and Gemini Pro with OCR and captioning.

quantitative_metrics.note: Accuracy, compared against a random baseline.

summary: EXAMS-V is a multilingual multimodal benchmark of 20,932 multiple-choice school exam questions delivered as image snapshots across 20 subjects and 11 languages. Evaluated VLMs and OCR/caption-augmented LLMs perform poorly, with the best only moderately above random.
key_findings: GPT-4V is the best VLM at 42.78% average accuracy (random 23.62%), Gemini-V gets 31.13%, and open-source VLMs are near random. GPT-4 with OCR and captions reaches the highest average at 47.11%. Chinese is near random for all models, and GPT-4V on parallel data scores Croatian (Latin) 62.56 vs Serbian (Cyrillic) 40.44.
gold_upstream: EXAMS (Hardalov et al., 2020), collected from official state examinations crafted by ministries of education; English and Chinese added from Gaokao and JEE Advanced. Answers come from the exams' official keys, although this paper does not describe how the answers were produced in detail.
facets_explanation: EXAMS-V extends the EXAMS dataset by retracing its original PDFs and adding Gaokao and JEE questions; authors drew bounding boxes and recorded metadata including the correct answer. Only questions with exactly one correct answer among 3-5 options are kept. Questions need subject and region-specific knowledge not in the image. Quality checks were by authors and colleagues, with no discussion of divergent readings.
results_explanation: Table 4: GPT-4 with OCR and captioning has Avg 47.11, the highest overall; GPT-4V is best VLM at 42.78 (random 23.62). Input gap: on Serbian, GPT-4 with OCR/captions scores 73.51 vs GPT-4V 39.84 (Table 4), about 34 points; on the parallel Serbian history-subject... the largest shown in Table 5 is Serbian Biology 73.11 vs 37.64, about 36 points, rounded to 37 from Serbian Informatics-free average 75.29 vs 40.44 = 34.85; reported as an approximate upper bound. The paper states a Croatian over Serbian gap for GPT-4V of 20.12% and attributes it to Latin vs Cyrillic script.

humanities_role.quote: covering natural science, social science, and other miscellaneous studies, e.g., religion, fine arts, business, etc.

dataset_size.quote: The EXAMS-V dataset contains 20,932 samples in total, spanning 20 subjects from grade 4-12.

evaluation_set_size.quote: Finally, we got 16,724 training and 4,208 test instances.

primary_evaluation_setting.quote: Our evaluation is conducted under a zero-shot setting without model finetuning or in-context learning

gold_source.quote: EXAMS-V is a multimodal extension of the EXAMS dataset (Hardalov et al., 2020)

gold_beyond_stimulus.quote: Questions related to Geography and History necessitate specific knowledge about particular regions or countries.

answer_multiplicity.quote: Only multiple-choice questions with 3 to 5 options and exactly one correct answer are considered

reported_format_gap_kind.quote: unlike prompt GPT-4V to directly generate the answer, augmented GPT-4 decouples the difficulties in visual information extraction and text reasoning.

reported_cultural_asymmetry.quote: For GPT-4V, there is a significant performance gap between Croatian and Serbian with Croatian outperforming Serbian by 20.12 %.
